scope: Mocked JSDOM requests only. Verifies cart preparation and read-only post-opener cart verification; no EasySell opening, app submission, native checkout or live cart was tested.
contract: SJCOD.prepare(items, {isReady}) returns a verified cart; synchronous isReady must confirm a supported opener and no other cart writer. SJCOD.verify(items) returns an exactly matching current cart or rejects, using only one GET. Both share SJCOD.busy. Other cart writers must respect the guard. Caller validates native quantity rules and owns UI/app handling.
